title: Jiraattota Iddoowwan Lamaan
intro: Biyya eebbi baayʼee itti yaaʼu keessatti, hawaasni tokko yeroo tokko iddoowwan biqiltuu dinqisiisoo lamaa baayʼee gammadaa ture. Jireenyi isaanii tola Waaqayyoof ragaa ture, ta’us seenaan isaanii yeroo galatni hir’atu garagalchee, jijjiirama warra yaadan hundaaf mallattoo waaraa ta’utti geesseera.
clues: Ummata biyya salphaa fi baay'inaan eebbifame turre.
Gooftaan keenya iddoowwan biqiltuu babbareedoo lama, gama hundaan lalisaa fi firii qaban nuuf kenne.
Galateeffannaa akka qabaannu ajajamne, garuu galata dhabuu filannee garagalle.
Hidhi guddaan tokko bishaan lafa keenyaaf jireenya kenne ofirraa ittise.
Badii keenya irratti yeroo itti cimne hidhichi dhoohee bishaan lolaa keessaa bahe.
Iddoowwan biqiltuu keenya yeroo tokko lalisaa taʼan, firii hadhaaʼaa, taamarii fi mukkeen lootee muraasaan bakka buʼaniiru.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Iddoowwan biqiltuu keenya firii hadhaaʼaa fi mukkeen baayʼee hin mulʼanneen bakka buufaman
outcome.answer: Iddoowwan biqiltuu keenya firii hadhaaʼaa fi mukkeen baayʼee hin mulʼanneen bakka buufaman

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
